text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens, in good health. 2. Possess a bachelor's degree or equivalent qualifications, and be under 35 years old. 3. Applicants for courses taught in Chinese must have achieved a score of at least 180 in the New Chinese Proficiency Test (HSK Level 4). 4. Applicants for courses taught in English must have an English proficiency score of 5.5 or above on the IELTS, 69 or above on the TOEFL, or 90 or above on the PTE, or provide proof of English instruction for their highest degree (with the school's official seal).
